key_parts.system:
You translate short plain-language lines from a rental housing law app into neutral Latin American Spanish, using "usted". The app shows the quoted law and "Not legal advice." next to each line.

Translate each sentence faithfully as one sentence. Keep every number, date, percentage and dollar amount exactly as written (digits stay digits; do not spell numbers out). Add nothing and leave nothing out. Do not add exemptions or any way to avoid a rule. Keep it short: at most 26 words. Return JSON with one entry per id given, in the same order.

input.answer_tenant: Your landlord cannot refuse to renew your lease, written or oral, without good cause.
input.answer_owner: You may not fail to renew a residential lease, written or oral, unless you have good cause.

input.answer_tenant: Your landlord cannot evict you just because your lease term has ended.
input.answer_owner: You cannot evict a tenant just because the lease term has ended.

input.answer_tenant: Your landlord cannot evict you or fail to renew your lease, written or oral, without good cause.
input.answer_owner: You may not evict a tenant or fail to renew a lease, written or oral, without good cause.

input.answer_tenant: Your landlord must notify you before an eviction suit for unpaid rent if you live in federally subsidized housing.
input.answer_owner: You must give the tenant notice before filing an eviction suit for unpaid rent in federally subsidized housing.

input.answer_tenant: You cannot be evicted for unpaid rent you used to keep utilities on that your landlord failed to pay.
input.answer_owner: You may not evict a tenant for unpaid rent used to keep utilities on that you were responsible for paying.

input.answer_tenant: Your landlord must serve a Notice to Quit at least three days prior to filing for disorderly conduct eviction.
input.answer_owner: You must serve a Notice to Quit at least three days prior to filing an eviction suit for disorderly conduct.

input.answer_tenant: You can be evicted if you intentionally or through gross negligence cause or allow damage to the property.
You can be evicted if you intentionally or through gross negligence cause or allow damage to the property.
Your landlord must serve you a Notice to Quit at least one month prior to filing an eviction suit.
input.answer_owner: You must serve a Notice to Quit at least one month prior to filing the eviction suit.

input.answer_tenant: Your landlord must serve a Notice to Quit at least one month prior to filing a lease-breach eviction suit.
input.answer_owner: You must serve a Notice to Quit at least one month prior to filing this type of eviction suit.

input.answer_tenant: Your landlord's rent increase must not be unconscionable and must follow all other laws, including rent control.
input.answer_owner: Your rent increase must not be unconscionable and must comply with all other laws, including rent control.

input.answer_tenant: Your landlord must serve a Notice to Quit at least three months before filing, and provide relocation assistance before eviction.
input.answer_owner: You must serve a Notice to Quit at least three months before filing, and provide relocation assistance before evicting.

answers.answer_tenant_es: Su arrendador no puede negarse a renovar su contrato de arrendamiento, escrito u oral, sin una causa justificada.
answers.answer_owner_es: Usted no puede dejar de renovar un contrato de arrendamiento residencial, escrito u oral, a menos que tenga una causa justificada.

answers.answer_tenant_es: Su arrendador no puede desalojarlo solo porque el plazo de su contrato de arrendamiento haya terminado.
answers.answer_owner_es: Usted no puede desalojar a un inquilino solo porque el plazo del contrato de arrendamiento haya terminado.

answers.answer_tenant_es: Su arrendador no puede desalojarlo ni dejar de renovar su contrato de arrendamiento, escrito u oral, sin una causa justificada.
answers.answer_owner_es: Usted no puede desalojar a un inquilino ni dejar de renovar un contrato de arrendamiento, escrito u oral, sin una causa justificada.

answers.answer_tenant_es: Su arrendador debe notificarle antes de una demanda de desalojo por falta de pago del alquiler si usted vive en una vivienda con subsidio federal.
answers.answer_owner_es: Usted debe dar aviso al inquilino antes de presentar una demanda de desalojo por falta de pago del alquiler en una vivienda con subsidio federal.

answers.answer_tenant_es: No pueden desalojarlo por el alquiler impago que usted usó para mantener los servicios públicos que su arrendador no pagó.
answers.answer_owner_es: Usted no puede desalojar a un inquilino por el alquiler impago usado para mantener los servicios públicos que a usted le correspondía pagar.

answers.answer_tenant_es: Su arrendador debe entregar un Aviso de Desocupación (Notice to Quit) al menos 3 días antes de presentar un desalojo por conducta desordenada.
answers.answer_owner_es: Usted debe entregar un Aviso de Desocupación (Notice to Quit) al menos 3 días antes de presentar una demanda de desalojo por conducta desordenada.

answers.answer_tenant_es: Pueden desalojarlo si usted causa o permite daños a la propiedad de forma intencional o por negligencia grave.
Pueden desalojarlo si usted causa o permite daños a la propiedad de forma intencional o por negligencia grave.
Su arrendador debe entregarle un Aviso de Desocupación (Notice to Quit) al menos 1 mes antes de presentar una demanda de desalojo.
answers.answer_owner_es: Usted debe entregar un Aviso de Desocupación (Notice to Quit) al menos 1 mes antes de presentar la demanda de desalojo.

answers.answer_tenant_es: Su arrendador debe entregar un Aviso de Desocupación (Notice to Quit) al menos 1 mes antes de presentar una demanda de desalojo por incumplimiento del contrato.
answers.answer_owner_es: Usted debe entregar un Aviso de Desocupación (Notice to Quit) al menos 1 mes antes de presentar este tipo de demanda de desalojo.

answers.answer_tenant_es: El aumento de alquiler de su arrendador no debe ser abusivo y debe cumplir todas las demás leyes, incluido el control de alquileres.
answers.answer_owner_es: Su aumento de alquiler no debe ser abusivo y debe cumplir todas las demás leyes, incluido el control de alquileres.

answers.answer_tenant_es: Su arrendador debe entregar un Aviso de Desocupación (Notice to Quit) al menos 3 meses antes de presentar la demanda, y ofrecer asistencia de reubicación antes del desalojo.
answers.answer_owner_es: Usted debe entregar un Aviso de Desocupación (Notice to Quit) al menos 3 meses antes de presentar la demanda, y ofrecer asistencia de reubicación antes de desalojar.
